Manifest.Name: Performance Fixes
Manifest.Author: KCN-judu
Manifest.Description: Fixes stutters in the base game without changing how it plays. Opening a full container no longer rebuilds every open window, because each container window gets its own canvas. Loading a save redraws each item once instead of every time one of its tags is restored. The parts of items, windows, inventories and machine panels are created where they belong instead of being moved there. Before a save loads, the early look at the store reads only its upgrades, and entering the store no longer rewrites the settings file for settings that did not change. Leaving the store frees its memory. Inventories are laid out once per frame instead of once per item change, which removes seconds from loading a large store. Selecting or dragging a large group of items no longer redraws its highlight and re-checks the whole formation every frame. A customer's buying check on nested storage runs once per item instead of re-checking everything inside, level after level. Customers accept and refuse exactly what they did before.
